dataModel.title: Data model
dataModel.subtitle: Add custom fields to the records your library keeps. Changes apply on the next form load — existing rows aren't touched.
dataModel.fieldsHint: Drag a field, or use the up/down arrows on its row, to reorder. Existing records keep their old values when you archive or restore a field.
dataModel.empty: No custom fields yet for this entity. Click "Add a field" to get started.
dataModel.previewHint: Live preview of the form your staff will fill in. Try typing — nothing is saved.
dataModel.form.fieldKeyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. We'll generate one from the label if you leave this blank.
dataModel.form.typeLocked: Type cannot change once a field exists — that's a safety rail against breaking existing records.
dataModel.form.requiredHint: When on, new records must provide a value. Existing records aren't affected.
dataModel.form.optionsHint: Each option needs an internal value (lowercase, no spaces) and at least one display label.
dataModel.form.optionsEmpty: At least one option is required for pick-one / pick-many fields.
dataModel.form.errors.labelRequired: The English or Greek label can't be blank.
dataModel.form.errors.fieldKeyInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores only. Start with a letter.
dataModel.toast.archived: Field archived. Existing values are kept; new records won't use it.
